settings.heading: Set up in under a minute
settings.text: No manual, no tools — just unfold, adjust and go.

settings.title: Unfold the legs
settings.text: Release the folded legs and stand the frame upright.

settings.title: Pick your height
settings.text: Slide to one of six height positions and lock it in.

settings.title: Set your angle
settings.text: Choose flat, reading or hobby angle for the tabletop.

settings.title: Position it
settings.text: Slide it over the sofa, bed or chair — no assembly required.

settings.title: Working & studying
settings.text: Standing or seated desk height, angled for comfortable typing.

settings.title: Meals & snacking
settings.text: Flat and stable, with a cup holder on Smart and Executive.

settings.title: Reading & hobbies
settings.text: Tilt the tabletop for books, drawing or craft projects.

settings.question: Do I need any tools?
settings.answer: No tools required — everything clicks into place by hand.

settings.question: How do I change the height?
settings.answer: Squeeze the adjustment clip on each leg and slide to your chosen position — six positions are available.

settings.question: How do I change the angle?
settings.answer: Tilt the tabletop and lock it into one of three angled positions using the hinge at the back edge.
